The Tolerance of the Rank Identity

Source: R/additive_penalty.R
additive_check_tol.Rd

Returns 1e-3, the relative departure from \(\sum_k\lambda_k\operatorname{tr}(S^{+}P_k) = r\) beyond which additive_sum() reports NaN instead of a number. The departure is taken relative to the rank \(r\).

Usage

additive_check_tol()

Value

A single number.

Details

The identity is exact, so a departure from it is accumulated rounding in the similarity transformation of additive_stable(). The threshold is chosen above the departures that rounding produces at points that the transformation resolves, so that a departure beyond it signals that the smaller eigenvalues have been lost. The threshold is not a bound on the error of the returned quantities: at a point that passes the check, the error of the log pseudo-determinant can exceed the departure from the identity.

See also

additive_sum(), which reads it.
